articles.title: Visa Unveils New Services to Modernize Dispute Resolution Process
articles.mainIdea: Visa Unveils New Services to Modernize Dispute Resolution Process
articles.summary: Business Wire: Visa Unveils New Services to Modernize Dispute Resolution Process. SAN FRANCISCO, April 01, 2026--Visa (NYSE: V), a global leader in digital payments, today announced six new dispute resolution tools designed to reduce the billions of dollars lost annually to inefficient, outdated dispute processes. The expanded suite of dispute resolution services is being designed to help merchants and financial institutions cut administrative costs, reduce fraud-related losses and redirect those resources toward growth, innovation and customer experience.
